# Google Ads Agent Skills

> Open-source skills, scripts and a playbook that let AI agents (Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Codex, Grok bots and others) audit and manage Google Ads accounts for lead generation businesses, with every change dry-run first and approved by a person. Includes a niche pack for real estate investors (home buyers and wholesalers). By White Space Solutions. MIT license.

Start with AGENTS.md. Every script takes --client clients/<slug>.yaml. Credentials live in .env (docs/setup.md).

## Agent entry points
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): where everything is, which skill to use, hard rules
- [README.md](README.md): overview, install, safety model, FAQ
- [docs/install.md](docs/install.md): installing in Claude Code, Cowork, Codex, Grok bots
- [docs/setup.md](docs/setup.md): Google Ads API developer token, OAuth, refresh token, MCC vs direct access

## Skills
- [skills/google-ads-setup/SKILL.md](skills/google-ads-setup/SKILL.md): connect an agent to a Google Ads account
- [skills/google-ads-audit/SKILL.md](skills/google-ads-audit/SKILL.md): full account audit, ranked fixes with evidence
- [skills/conversion-tracking-audit/SKILL.md](skills/conversion-tracking-audit/SKILL.md): offline conversion uploads, value drift, goals
- [skills/negative-keyword-audit/SKILL.md](skills/negative-keyword-audit/SKILL.md): negative keyword rebuild with four safety gates
- [skills/search-term-review/SKILL.md](skills/search-term-review/SKILL.md): weekly search term review
- [skills/keyword-research/SKILL.md](skills/keyword-research/SKILL.md): keyword themes with Keyword Planner data
- [skills/generate-ads/SKILL.md](skills/generate-ads/SKILL.md): responsive search ads and assets
- [skills/build-campaign/SKILL.md](skills/build-campaign/SKILL.md): build a full Search campaign from a plan, paused, dry run first
- [skills/landing-page-check/SKILL.md](skills/landing-page-check/SKILL.md): landing page health and tracking
- [skills/ppc-weekly-routine/SKILL.md](skills/ppc-weekly-routine/SKILL.md): weekly management loop
- [skills/apply-google-ads-changes/SKILL.md](skills/apply-google-ads-changes/SKILL.md): safe change protocol and rollback

## Niche pack: real estate investors (home buyers, wholesalers)
- [niches/real-estate-investors/README.md](niches/real-estate-investors/README.md): seller search intent, words that look like junk but are sellers
- [niches/real-estate-investors/negatives.yaml](niches/real-estate-investors/negatives.yaml): five starter negative lists
- [niches/real-estate-investors/allow-list.txt](niches/real-estate-investors/allow-list.txt): seller searches never to block
- [niches/real-estate-investors/keyword-themes.md](niches/real-estate-investors/keyword-themes.md): campaign and ad group themes
- [niches/real-estate-investors/ad-copy.md](niches/real-estate-investors/ad-copy.md): seller ad angles and compliance
- [niches/real-estate-investors/benchmarks.md](niches/real-estate-investors/benchmarks.md): 2026 CPC and cost per qualified lead ranges
- [niches/real-estate-investors/launch-plan.md](niches/real-estate-investors/launch-plan.md): launching a new account: budget, order, bidding, first 90 days
- [niches/real-estate-investors/campaign-template.yaml](niches/real-estate-investors/campaign-template.yaml): ready-to-edit spec for a Sell House Fast Search campaign
- [niches/real-estate-investors/conversion-setup.md](niches/real-estate-investors/conversion-setup.md): lead stages, stage values, CRM offline conversion uploads, call tracking
- [niches/real-estate-investors/landing-pages.md](niches/real-estate-investors/landing-pages.md): seller landing pages by theme
